messages:
michael: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a compact closure plan for the routing-induced eviction incident. List owners, short triage steps, and a couple of oncall commands. Keep replies short.

sophia: I'll own the runbook edits (TL;DR, triage checklist, immediate mitigations). Due 2024-10-10. Owner: @sophia.

drew: I'll add exact diagnostic commands and a small diagnostic script. Snippet:```
# check runtime pods and recent restarts
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n redwood get events --since=15m | grep -i eviction
# fetch kv cache stats
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/kv | jq .
```

li: I'll own the escalation flow and alert rules. Draft alert below — will add to playbook:```
- alert: RoutingEvictionSpike
  expr: (rate(runtime_errors_total[5m]) > 0.02) and (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.9)
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Eviction-like pattern: errors + p95 latency spike"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-evictions"
```

michael: Good. Add a safe mitigation command for oncall (no full restart):```
# temporarily cap sequence length
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.dev/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"max_seq":1024}'
# redirect route to fallback variant
redwoodctl routing set --route=chat-api --variant=fallback --force --note "oncall mitigation"
```

sophia: Adding that under "Immediate mitigations". Also adding a short "when to abort rollout" checklist (p95 up 30% OR errors x2 for 5m).

drew: Proposed tracking tickets:
- RW-INC-5340 runbook edits (owner: sophia) due 2024-10-10
- RW-INC-5341 diag commands + scripts (owner: drew) due 2024-10-08
- RW-INC-5342 escalation + alerts (owner: li) due 2024-10-09
I'll create them after we confirm owners.

li: Add rollout policy: any routing weight bump >15% requires a canary plan + SRE signoff. I'll add this to the playbook.

michael: Also schedule a 90-day verification cadence: weekly checks month 1, monthly months 2-3. Ops-bot, please remind owners 48h before due dates.

ops-bot: Reminder set  I will send reminders 48 hours before each due date and on PR merge.

sophia: Reviewers: @drew (infra) and @li (sre). PR will be up by tomorrow morning.

drew: I'll post the diagnostic script as a gist and link it in RW-INC-5341.

li: I'll add a short flowchart to the playbook: metric check -> collect artifacts -> mitigation -> page -> followup.
